svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.23.14.2 Framing around Openings
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.23 WOOD-FRAME CONSTRUCTION

g.text: Not wider than 2 spacings: doubling not
Wider than 2 spacings: members doubled on
Applies to roof and ceiling framing members around openings.
Measured in rafter or joist spacings.
Shown with ceiling joists at 400 mm o.c. Doubled members in yellow in B.

svg.text: Roof and ceiling framing members are doubled
on each side of openings greater than 2 rafter
Drawn: in B the members on all four sides of the opening are doubled. Sizes are illustration only.
Metric values quoted from the code · imperial in brackets converted · ACCESS Indigenous Skills4Success
